SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date, mailing_list_size, holdout_size, holdout_pct
FROM dim_campaign
WHERE campaign_name LIKE '%Black Week%' OR campaign_name LIKE '%BW%'
ORDER BY start_date DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as holdout_count
FROM campaign_holdout
WHERE campaign_id = 15

-- Check the date range of sales during Black Week 2025
SELECT MIN(sale_date) as min_date, MAX(sale_date) as max_date, COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'

-- Calculate total spend and unique member counts for targeted vs holdout during campaign
WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT 
    member_id,
    CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15) 
         THEN 'holdout' 
         ELSE 'targeted' 
    END as member_group
  FROM dim_member
  WHERE member_key IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_key FROM fact_sales_line
    WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
  )
)
SELECT member_group, COUNT(*) as member_count
FROM campaign_members
GROUP BY member_group

-- Calculate total spend per group during Black Week 2025 campaign
WITH sales_with_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    f.net_amount,
    d.member_id,
    CASE WHEN d.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15) 
         THEN 'holdout' 
         ELSE 'targeted' 
    END as member_group
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_member d ON f.member_key = d.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
    AND d.member_id IS NOT NULL  -- exclude non-members if any
)
SELECT 
  member_group,
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) as total_net_amount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as unique_members
FROM sales_with_groups
GROUP BY member_group

-- Final calculation: Average spend per member and uplift
WITH campaign_data AS (
  SELECT 23826 as targeted_members, 2747 as holdout_members
),
spend_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN d.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15) 
         THEN 'holdout' 
         ELSE 'targeted' 
    END as member_group,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_member d ON f.member_key = d.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
    AND d.member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY member_group
)
SELECT 
  'Targeted' as group_name,
  ROUND((SELECT total_net_amount FROM spend_data WHERE member_group = 'targeted') / 23826, 2) as avg_spend_per_member
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Held-out' as group_name,
  ROUND((SELECT total_net_amount FROM spend_data WHERE member_group = 'holdout') / 2747, 2) as avg_spend_per_member
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Uplift (€)' as group_name,
  ROUND((SELECT total_net_amount FROM spend_data WHERE member_group = 'targeted') / 23826 
         - (SELECT total_net_amount FROM spend_data WHERE member_group = 'holdout') / 2747, 2) as avg_spend_per_member
calls.output_preview:

-- Final query: Black Week 2025 campaign uplift analysis
WITH campaign_targets AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15) 
         THEN 'holdout' 
         ELSE 'targeted' 
    END as member_group,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_member d ON f.member_key = d.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
    AND d.member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY member_group
)
SELECT 
  'Average spend per targeted member' as metric,
  ROUND((SELECT total_net_amount FROM campaign_targets WHERE member_group = 'targeted') / 23826, 2) as amount_eur
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Average spend per held-out member' as metric,
  ROUND((SELECT total_net_amount FROM campaign_targets WHERE member_group = 'holdout') / 2747, 2) as amount_eur
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Uplift in euros per member' as metric,
  ROUND((SELECT total_net_amount FROM campaign_targets WHERE member_group = 'targeted') / 23826 
         - (SELECT total_net_amount FROM campaign_targets WHERE member_group = 'holdout') / 2747, 2) as amount_eur
